    Compilation Method (Windows, Using CMake, C++)

    This section explains how to build on Windows.

    #contents

    Preparing the Environment

    Environment

    Visual C++ (version 2005 or later) VC++ development environment
    CMake (version 2.8.5 or later) A tool for generating build files suitable for the development environment
    Doxygen Documentation generator
    Graphviz A tool for outputting graph structures written in the dot language as images
    Wix Windows Installer XML toolset (version 3.5 or later) A toolset for creating Windows Installer (MSI) packages

    If the directories where Wix and Graphviz are installed (C:\Program Files (x86)\WiX Toolset v3.11\bin, C:\Program Files (x86)\Graphviz2.44.1\bin) are not set in the PATH environment variable, set them.

    After installing Graphviz, check the plugin registration status with the dot -v command. For the procedure, see this page.

    Build Procedure

    The build procedure is shown below. The figures use VC++ 2017 and CMake 3.14.1.

    CMake Settings

    Start the GUI version of CMake and specify the directories.

    Where is the source code Specify the folder containing the code generated by RTCBuilder.
    Where to build the binaries Specify the folder where files such as the solution, project, and workspace files will be output.
    Specifying the Directories


    Running Configure

    Click the [Configure] button to run it. Then select the platform to use. In this example, “Visual Studio 15 2017” is selected.

    Selecting the Platform


    Enabling BUILD_DOCUMENTATION

    Enable the BUILD_DOCUMENTATION option to generate documentation.

    Enabling BUILD_DOCUMENTATION


    Running Generate

    After Configure completes successfully, click the [Generate] button.

    Running Generate


    Running VC++

    Press the [Open Project] button to open the solution file (*.sln).

    Running the Build

    Run [Build] > [Build Solution] to build the solution.

    Running the Build


    Documentation Generation Procedure

    Running doxygen

    In Solution Explorer, select “doc” and right-click it. Then select “Build” and run it.

    Running doxygen


    Documentation

    The documentation is generated in doc/html/doxygen/html under the folder specified in “Where to build the binaries”.

    Documentation Example


    Package Generation Procedure

    Package generation uses cpack, which is included with CMake, and Wix.

    Running the PACKAGE Build

    In Solution Explorer, select “PACKAGE” and right-click it. Then select “Build” and run it.

    Running the PACKAGE Build


    Package

    An msi-format installation package is generated under the folder specified in “Where to build the binaries”.

    _rtm120_win64.msi When this installation package is executed, it is installed in the following location. `C:\Program Files\OpenRTM-aist\1.2.0\Components\\\`
